basis_note: Each pattern below requires combining two or more of this case's own investigation threads or DFAPTA paths to see - none of them is visible from any single thread in data/threads.json read alone. This is a reading of what's already in the frozen evidence register (EV-0001-EV-0827) and DFAPTA Cycle 1, not new evidence.

patterns.title: Four claim-verification threads share one missing document
patterns.description: Trial Evaluation (THR-01), Petition Claim Verification (THR-02), Causal Attribution (THR-03), and Technical/Operational Architecture (THR-05) each independently reach the same wall: no complete NSW Police evaluation of the Moree trial has been publicly located. The petition's 50% crime figure, its arrest/recovery/missing-person aggregates, its deployment-speed metric, and any causal attribution to PolAir-Remote all separately require the same single document to resolve. Four threads that look independent in the register are, read together, one evidence gap.
patterns.basis: Restates DFAPTA AR-003, AR-004, AR-006 and AR-007, made visible only by reading the four threads side by side rather than one at a time.

patterns.title: Expansion infrastructure moved faster than accountability infrastructure
patterns.description: Procurement and Statewide RPAS Architecture (THR-07) and Political Provenance (THR-09) show a program that was already being scaled - a second procurement EOI, public ministerial contemplation of Kempsey, statewide capability planning - months before the petition. Privacy/AI/Biometric Governance (THR-06), Oversight and Complaint Architecture (THR-10), and Primary Record Acquisition (THR-12) show that no controlling operational policy, no AI Assessment Framework determination, and no independent oversight finding have been publicly located for the same program. Read together: the expansion machinery is ahead of the accountability machinery, not running alongside it.
patterns.basis: Combines DFAPTA AR-002, AR-012, AR-013, AR-016 and AR-021; matches this case's own open-question cluster (Q-0005, Q-0006, Q-0011, Q-0012, Q-0014, Q-0018) without adding anything beyond it.

patterns.title: The petition's political provenance is well-documented; its factual claims are not
patterns.description: This case can state with confidence who promoted the petition, when, through what channel, against what prior political and institutional backdrop (THR-09) - that thread is comparatively well-evidenced. The petition's own six headline numeric claims (THR-02) and the causal mechanism behind them (THR-03) remain almost entirely unverified. The asymmetry is itself a finding: this investigation can describe the petition's politics with more confidence than its facts.
patterns.basis: Direct read of the Evidence Register against Threads 02, 03 and 09; matches DFAPTA AR-002 through AR-006 read as a set.

patterns.title: Consultation and rollout design share the same missing input: a scale definition
patterns.description: Consultation and Shared Governance (THR-08) and Mid North Coast Rollout Design (THR-11) look like separate topics - one about process, one about engineering - but both stall on the same undefined quantity: what geographic scale is actually being proposed. Moree's own consultation could not test community reaction to a defined Mid North Coast model because no such model existed to consult on, and no rollout design exists today for the same reason. Neither thread can progress independently of the other resolving first.
patterns.basis: Combines DFAPTA AR-015 and AR-017; the petition's own undefined "Mid North Coast" wording is the shared root cause named in both.

patterns.title: One acquisition mechanism resolves nearly every other thread
patterns.description: Six segmented GIPA applications (THR-12) already exist, each mapped to specific gaps in Trial Evaluation, Technical/Operational Architecture, Privacy/AI Governance, Procurement, Consultation, and Rollout Design. This is unusual: most investigations accumulate open questions faster than they accumulate acquisition routes for them. Here, of this case's 18 open questions, 16 already resolve through one of six already-drafted, unlodged applications - the bottleneck is execution, not design.
patterns.basis: Direct read of data/open_questions.json's likely_source field against the GIPA Primary Record Acquisition Pack (EV-0034, EV-0822-EV-0827); restates DFAPTA AR-021 and CPO-006.

patterns.title: Two messaging contradictions and one continuation finding trace to the same absent document
patterns.description: The reactive-versus-proactive contradiction (CTR-0001), the crime-only-versus-multi-purpose contradiction (CTR-0002), and the finding that the trial continued past its own stated six-month window with no visible exit criteria are three distinct register entries. All three resolve, and only resolve, through the same missing controlling operational policy document - the same document Trial Evaluation (THR-01) needs to close its own central open question.
patterns.basis: Combines DFAPTA AR-010, AR-011 and AR-014; both Contradiction Register entries and Q-0005/Q-0017 converge on one document.

patterns.title: Economic and causal-attribution gaps are the same unresolved question at different scales
patterns.description: Causal Attribution (THR-03) asks whether PolAir-Remote caused Moree's crime decline, net of confounding interventions. The Technical/Operational Architecture thread's economic material (from the Snapshot 6 findings) asks whether PolAir-Remote's system cost is justified net of downstream justice-system cost. Both are, structurally, the same question - net effect after accounting for a downstream system the headline claim ignores - asked once about crime and once about cost.
patterns.basis: Combines DFAPTA AR-006 and AR-018; CPO-008 states this same convergence at the DFAPTA level.

patterns.title: Baseline convergence: a real capability outrunning its own evidentiary and governance base
patterns.description: Read across all twelve threads, the case converges on one structural picture: a tactically real capability (THR-04, THR-05), inside an active expansion trajectory that predates its own public petition (THR-07, THR-09), whose specific claims are unverified (THR-01, THR-02, THR-03) and whose governance documentation has not kept pace with its operational and procurement momentum (THR-06, THR-08, THR-10, THR-11) - with a concrete, already-drafted acquisition plan sitting unexecuted (THR-12).
patterns.basis: Restates DFAPTA AR-022 (the baseline structural determination) and CPO-010, at the thread-topology level rather than the evidence-anchor level.

not_claimed: No claim is made about why the governance documentation lags the operational/procurement momentum (LP-002, LP-006) - only that it does, on the public record.
No claim is made that the six GIPA applications (LP-005) will actually be granted, or in what form - only that they are drafted, specific, and unlodged.
No forward projection is made here - see temporal-projection-integrity-engine/ for what the current trajectory suggests, stated as judgement with its own explicit limits.
